# Master Smile Studio - International Oral Health & Dental Implantology Clinic, Antalya Turkey

> Master Smile Studio is an internationally certified oral surgery, advanced implantology, and cosmetic smile design polyclinic located in Antalya, Turkey. Certified and licensed by the Republic of Turkey Ministry of Health for International Health Tourism.

## 🦷 Core Dental Treatments & Clinical Protocols

### 1. All-on-4 & All-on-6 Full Arch Dental Implants
- **Definition:** The surgical insertion of 4 or 6 medical-grade titanium implants per arch to support a fixed, full-arch monolithic zirconia bridge without bone grafting.
- **Duration:** 2 Visits (Visit 1: 3-5 days for surgery & same-day fixed temporary teeth; Visit 2 after 3 months: 5-7 days for permanent monolithic zirconia prosthetics).
- **Brands Used:** Straumann Roxolid SLActive (Switzerland), DXL (Germany), NucleOSS (Turkey), Megagen (South Korea).
- **Warranty:** Lifetime International Manufacturer Passport & Warranty.

### 2. Monolithic Zirconium Crowns & Bridges
- **Definition:** 100% metal-free, 1200+ MPa flexural strength biocompatible zirconia crowns designed via 3D CAD/CAM milling for ultimate durability and natural translucency.
- **Duration:** 4-6 Days (Single Visit).
- **Warranty:** 5-Year Comprehensive Clinical Warranty.

### 3. IPS e.max Porcelain Laminate Veneers (Hollywood Smile)
- **Definition:** Ultra-thin (0.3mm - 0.5mm) lithium disilicate glass-ceramic veneers preserving 95% of natural tooth enamel with optical depth matching natural teeth.
- **Duration:** 5-7 Days (Single Visit).
